title: Text-to-image/video generation
reading: A largely visual slide showcasing outputs of modern generative models for text-to-image, text-to-video, and novel-view/3D synthesis. Named systems include DALL·E 2, Muse, Stable Diffusion, and Stable Zero123, with no accompanying body text beyond the title and product labels.

visuals.description: Grid of DALL·E 2 sample images (goldfish in bowl, avocado, astronaut, neon shapes) with the DALL·E 2 logo.
visuals.assertion: Diffusion-based text-to-image models produce diverse, photorealistic and stylized images from prompts.

visuals.description: Muse sample: birthday cake with candles spelling 'MUSE'.
visuals.assertion: Muse can render legible text-shaped objects within generated scenes.

visuals.description: Stable Diffusion sample strip: astronaut playing piano, unicorn, otter in Victorian dress, bear in spacesuit.
visuals.assertion: Stable Diffusion generates imaginative compositions combining unrelated concepts.

visuals.description: Four frames of generated video-like scenes: rocket launch, Earth from orbit, miniature village at night, cloudy seascape.
visuals.assertion: Text-to-video models generate coherent cinematic scenes.

visuals.description: Stable Zero123 row showing a cartoon dinosaur rendered from five different viewpoints.
visuals.assertion: Zero-shot novel view synthesis produces consistent 3D-aware renderings of an object from a single image.

concepts.name: Text-to-image generation
concepts.why_it_matters: Core generative task illustrated by the examples.

concepts.name: Text-to-video generation
concepts.why_it_matters: Extends generation to the temporal domain.
